sources.title: LiveCodeBench: Holistic and Contamination Free Evaluation of Large ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we propose LiveCodeBench, a comprehensive and contamination-free evaluation of LLMs for code, which collects new problems over time from contests across three competition platforms, namely LeetCode, AtCoder, and CodeForces.
